name: Wheel Coaster
description: You cannot control the forward and backward rotation of this wheel, but it can be locked into place by sending an on signal to the brake input.
shortDescription: Simple small wheel that requires no engine power and spins freely.

logicNodes.label: Brake
logicNodes.description: Locks the wheel into place when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Variable Brake
logicNodes.description: A value between 0 and 1 for soft braking
